title: Finite Dependence and Invariance Hierarchies for Finitely Supported Structures
summary: Finite support indicates that the dependence is limited, but not how each finite context controls what can be observed. For a data symmetry G \leq Sym(A) and a finitely supported G-set X, we study the finite-dependence profile X^S = {x : Fix_G(S) fixes x}, indexed by finite contexts S \subseteq A. For relations on A^n this yields Boolean algebras B^{(n)}_{G,S} = Inv_n(Fix_G(S)), forming the invariance hierarchy. The hierarchy separates several nominal principles.
